title: FTUE sample story choices
what: Summons 1- then 2-reply beats. Tap-hand mirrored on the phrase start edge; on two replies it fades from one choice onto the other.
author: victoria

title: Claim CTA: pulse + soft glow
what: Wrong target — end-of-story claim button experiments. Kept for reference; dialogue choices live in FTUE dialogue choices.
author: victoria

title: Key Pad
what: The code entry at the end of The Summons: Victoria's envelope with a bubble magnifier and a glowing keypad, plus a QWERTY version for word codes.
author: melissa

title: Audio matched to paragraphs
what: Six narrated Story City stories with each paragraph timed to its audio, shown as a chat, a visual novel and a lines-to-audio timeline. Tap a paragraph to play from it; the line being spoken stays lit until the next one starts. The volume slider follows a squared curve, so halfway is a quarter of the gain.
author: brett

title: Visual novel reader on a phone
what: The chapter's featured image on top and the paragraph being spoken underneath, sized for a phone. The previous paragraph stays until the next one starts. Same six stories as Audio matched to paragraphs.
author: brett

title: Story overview: audio preview
what: Side-by-side swipe carousel for Meet the cast. Place tip + solid debug toggle.
author: victoria

title: Decrypt the Artwork
what: Reader chapter with the glowing Decrypt the Artwork ticket. Tap it to open Decrypt the Puzzle, pick a colour, then Select colour.
author: victoria

title: Dragon's name: word jumble
what: Three empty slots and a tray of little tags, two of them decoys. Drag (or tap) the right tags into the slots to build sharp-toothed green-eyed fire-eater.
author: brett

title: Dragon's name: text entry
what: The app moment as specced: a text box with the hint "The dragon's full name". Close spellings of sharp-toothed-green-eyed-fire-eater are accepted.
author: brett

title: Narrated reader: synced chat
what: A narrated story in the chat-bubble reader: narration centred with no bubble, characters on the left, your choices on the right. The line being spoken is lit and earlier lines dim; choices pause the audio.
author: melissa

title: Narrated reader: as a text story
what: The same chapter as a plain text story, no audio bar: typing dots, tap to skip. Shows one reader view works for both kinds of story.
author: melissa

title: Narrated reader: captions over art
what: For comparison: full-screen art with the current line and the one before it as captions, plus the same audio bar and choice buttons.
author: melissa

title: Decrypt race
what: Tap Decrypt the Letter. One glowing dot pops up at a time somewhere on the pixelated picture. Hit 10 of them to clear the letter. You can zoom in.
author: victoria

title: The Decryptor
what: The Summons letter comes back pixelated. Three colour swatches point into it: photograph something nearby in the same colour family to clear each patch, get an accuracy score for each, and a shareable match card at the end.
author: melissa

title: Map modes: always a pin
what: No Pin mode: just Walk and Hunt, with whatever the chapter needs (a fountain, a street corner, a bench) always pinned nearby. Reaching the pin unlocks the chapter in either mode.
author: melissa

title: Map modes: Walk, Pin, Hunt
what: One map, three ways to unlock the next chapter: Walk, Pin and Hunt, switched from the chapter card. Steps always count when you switch, and there's a "no pin nearby" state.
author: melissa

title: First steps: The Summons
what: First-time user tour. The welcome screen glitches and Wren, a secret-society agent, hacks in to teach location, walk to unlock, the colour-photo puzzle, nearby spots, a scavenger hunt, a first location gem, sign-up and the paywall.
author: melissa

title: First steps: The Knight
what: The same tour told by Sir Wendell, a knight chasing an invisible dragon: parchment-scrap messages on a castle wall, a torn-map jigsaw, and olde-English lines.
author: melissa

title: Chat chapter
what: The opening of Operation COPY/WRITE told as a text-message thread, with typing indicators and crisp-E hijacking the chat.
author: brett

title: Glitch Lab
what: Seven hack and signal-loss effects for the chat chapter, one button each. Full hack chains them into crisp-E taking over the thread.
author: brett

title: The Remixer
what: crisp-E's remix tool at Loc 3i: three tabs of one-tap effects (Mix it, Shape it, Wreck it), colour and contrast grids, and a draggable Lens. Save unlocks after any 2 tools.
author: melissa

title: Remix a masterpiece
what: Stamp a photo onto a public-domain painting, then pixelate, smear and recolour it. Superseded by The Remixer.
author: brett
